name: tony-prod
description: Production hub for a video production team: chat, calendar, productions, tasks, documents and announcements.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client
